verdict.rationale: Docs show a simple, low-friction install path (`/skills`, `$skill-installer <name>`, `/plugins` browser, `codex plugin marketplace add`) and a probe confirms a real, keyless one-line install (`npx skills add ... --skill plugin-creator`) landing a valid SKILL.md in seconds, consistent with a sub-five-minute quickstart. Missing for 10: an explicit timed quickstart walkthrough or independent report confirming end-to-end time, and any friction/troubleshooting notes from first-time users.
